limitations: The brief-only identity proof uses a goal whose derived slug lands in this task's own wr28- namespace, because the program contract reserves the others. The derivation exercised is the shipped default; only the words of the goal were chosen. The host-slug write path was never executed by anyone — it no longer exists in code.

Identity resolution is check-then-write, not a lock: two createSite calls resolving the same derived base id in the same instant could still collide. Named, not fixed; nothing in this repo runs createSite concurrently.

The browser coverage added here is for the LIBRARY SCREEN (tables, warnings, adaptation notes) against an editor server with no open site. The Create Site FORM is browser-driven by scripts/smoke-first-draft.ts; the Template Library row's 'Edit' path is still covered at the data/HTTP level only.
